 Action required: API Keys with duration longer than 30 days will expire on November 1, 2026. Starting August 17 2026, new keys are limited to maximum of 30 days. If you're using GitHub Actions or GitLab, we recommend switching to Trusted Publishing. Learn more
An API key is a token that can identify you to NuGet Gallery. The NuGet command-line utility allows you to submit a NuGet package to the gallery using your API key to authenticate.

Always keep your API keys a secret! If an API key is ever exposed, revoke it immediately and generate a new one to maintain security.
